question: Under what condition may a teacher grant the boon of long life to a disciple?
premises: The disciple must be thoroughly examined
Examination should be done carefully and always
Only then may long life be given
inference: A teacher may grant long life only after carefully examining the recipient
uncertainties: The object cirajīvitam may refer to a boon or teaching associated with long life
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one may give him long life.
